//: Used in: hooks/useCreateShare.ts (useCreateShare namespace). User-facing alerts for create-share domain errors, shown by the hook for BOTH surfaces (picker confirm + opportunity sheet). Keep tight and friendly, actionable not scary.
alreadyTodayMessage: You've already shared {{business}} today. You can share them again tomorrow.
alreadyStoryMessage: You've already turned this story into a share.
budgetMessage: {{business}} has run out of budget right now. Try again later, or share another place.
noRewardMessage: We couldn't work out a reward for this story yet. Give it a little time after posting, then try again.
storyExpiredMessage: This story isn't live on your Instagram anymore. Pick another one to share.
storyMediaUnavailableMessage: It most likely uses copyrighted music. Repost it without music and try again.
instagramMessage: We couldn't reach your Instagram. Reconnect it and try again.
notTaggedMessage: Your story needs to clearly tag {{business}} to earn. Post a story that tags them, then try again.
genericMessage: Something went wrong creating your share. Please try again.
